components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast scarlet CTA with sharp 0px corners and bone-white hover inversion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E60000; color: #050505; padding: 16px 28px; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px -10px rgba(138, 0, 10, 0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F5EFE6; color: #050505; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1F1F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Stage Button
components.description: Obsidian stage button with 1px crimson border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0A0607; color: #F5EFE6; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 0, 0, 0.6); border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(74, 0, 6, 0.6); border-color: #F5EFE6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1F1F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Transmission Dispatch Input
components.description: Zero-radius darkroom input with deferred :user-invalid validation.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(19, 9, 11, 0.92); color: #F5EFE6; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 0, 0, 0.38); border-radius: 0px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.22s, box-shadow 0.22s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A88B89; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #FF1F1F; box-shadow: 0 14px 32px -8px rgba(230, 0, 0, 0.28); outline: none; }

narrative.overview: AFTERHRS PRODUCTIONS rejects conventional event-marketing templates, SaaS card grids, and decorative neon gradients in favor of an architectural nocturnal soundstage drenched in arterial blood red (#E60000), deep crimson (#8A000A), burnt thermal orange (#D94E0F), and pitch black (#050505).
keyCharacteristics: Full-commitment crimson and pitch-black palette with crimson-tinted secondary copy (never neutral gray).
Zero-radius (0px) brutalist geometry anchored by exposed 1px crimson hairlines.
Self-hosted variable typography pairing Big Shoulders Display with Unbounded and Bricolage Grotesque.
Unified Lenis + GSAP ScrollTrigger choreography and offscreen-paused React Three Fiber custom GLSL shaders.

rules.name: The Crimson-Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Secondary and muted text on dark surfaces must be tinted from the crimson/bone spectrum (#D4BDBC, #A88B89), never neutral gray.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) always lead at the top of their container and speak for themselves; never place a small eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.

dos: Do preserve the authentic warped AFTERHRS letterforms and official Instagram plates (/brand/afterhrs-*.jpg).
Do start every heading (h1, h2, h3) at the top of its block without an eyebrow or kicker above it.
Do keep unconfirmed event details as explicit COMING SOON placeholders governed by src/config/event.ts.
Do pause heavy WebGL rendering when offscreen and respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't invent fake event dates, venues, lineups, ticket prices, or stock crowd photography.
Don't use rounded SaaS cards (border-radius > 0), gradient text, or neutral gray secondary text.
Don't autoplay audio under any circumstance; sound must be explicitly toggled by the visitor.
